title: Copilot Studio: credit costs per agent and by lifecycle stage in the Monitor tab
summary: Pass. The roadmap facts, admin paths and allocation API match the sources, including the qualifications on spending limits. The briefing distinguishes the planned change from existing Monitor documentation and leaves unpublished rollout and licensing details open.

claims.quote: an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The cost display reports consumption rather than enforcing a cap or stopping agents; no control specific to this roadmap cost view is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Monitor cost visibility; Copilot Studio Monitor cost enable; opened analytics-overview, authoring-review-activity, analytics-consumption and manage-usage-microsoft-copilot-harness. Monitor reports usage; separate agent and environment controls enforce limits.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing administrator-managed capacity and agent consumption controls govern the spending reported by Monitor.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The standard-harness Monitor billing view shows billed credits only and can show less consumption than admin reports.
claims.quote: It shows billed credits only, so it can show less consumption than these reports, which also include non-billed credits.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center consumption reports include non-billed credits.
claims.quote: these reports, which also include non-billed credits.

claims.claim: Learn describes a Copilot Studio licence as providing a specified quantity of billed Copilot Credits pooled across the tenant.
claims.quote: When you purchase a Copilot Studio license, you get a specified number of billed Copilot Credits pooled across the tenant.

claims.claim: The cited capacity page says those purchased credits must be assigned to an environment to enable agent features there.
claims.quote: You must assign these credits to an environment to enable Copilot Studio features for agents in that environment.

claims.claim: Per-agent monthly limits, notifications and hard stops are managed in Power Platform admin center at Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents.
claims.quote: On the navigation pane, select **Licensing**. ... In the **Licensing** pane, under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**. ... On the **Summary** tab, select **Manage Agents**.

claims.claim: An API or command for the per-agent monthly credit limit is not documented in the references found.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform API Copilot Studio agent monthly credit limit automation Dataverse bot limit; Copilot Studio agent limit pac admin PowerShell; Dataverse bot monthly credit limit. Opened capacity, harness-cost and governance pages; no agent-limit operation was found.

claims.claim: The governance article describes applying individual agent limits through a recurring or automated process without naming an API operation for the limit.
claims.quote: Power Platform admin center doesn't provide a tenant-wide default agent limit. If your organization defines a standard limit for new agents, use a recurring or automated process to apply it to individual agents.

claims.claim: Agent credit limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: Environment allocation and tenant-capacity draw are managed at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: select **Licensing**. ... under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**. ... Select the **Summary** tab. ... Under the **Copilot Studio** heading, select **Manage Copilot Credits** or **Manage sessions**.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 accepts scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements containing MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and enforcementRules.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: The enforcement-rule placeholder is an object with ruleType TenantPool and a boolean enabled value controlling tenant-capacity draw.
claims.quote: @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }

claims.claim: A published environment-group rule for tenant-capacity draw prevents an individual environment override.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant**, you can't override the setting for an individual environment.

claims.claim: UI and API attempts to override that group-governed setting are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the `TenantPoolLockedByPolicy` error.

claims.claim: Learn says to change and republish the environment-group rule when changing that group-governed setting.
claims.quote: Change and republish the rule for the environment group

claims.claim: Removing the environment from its group allows independent management of tenant-capacity draw.
claims.quote: remove the environment from the group ... to manage the setting independently. After removal, the environment retains the value last applied by the group, but the setting becomes editable.

claims.claim: Managing allocations requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role permitted to manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the **Power Platform Administrator** or **Global Administrator** role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows called by the agent.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.claim: Individual agent limits do not cap aggregate environment consumption.
claims.quote: Agent limits don't cap aggregate environment consumption.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center has no tenant-wide default agent limit.
claims.quote: Power Platform admin center doesn't provide a tenant-wide default agent limit.

claims.claim: An organisation's standard limit for new agents must be applied to the individual agents rather than inherited from a tenant-wide default.
claims.quote: If your organization defines a standard limit for new agents, use a recurring or automated process to apply it to individual agents.

claims.claim: Learn points to Power Platform API entitlement insight operations for retrieving consumption programmatically.
claims.quote: At scale or when using automation, use the entitlement insight operations in the Power Platform API to retrieve consumption data programmatically.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio environment and agent spending policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center are opt-in.
claims.quote: Copilot Studio environment and agent policies are opt-in

claims.claim: Existing Power Platform controls continue to apply until a Microsoft 365 spending policy covers the relevant scope.
claims.quote: existing Power Platform admin center controls continue to apply until a Microsoft 365 spending policy covers that scope.

claims.claim: Makers open Monitor by opening an agent in Copilot Studio and selecting Monitor.
claims.quote:
1. Open your agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select **Monitor**.

claims.claim: The documented Microsoft Copilot harness Monitor tab can be opened before publishing.
claims.quote: You can open the **Monitor** tab before you publish your agent.

claims.claim: The documented Monitor production usage, feedback and credit data appear after publishing and usage.
claims.quote: Production usage, feedback, and credit data appear after you publish the agent and people start using it.

claims.claim: The documented Monitor sessions list contains only the past 28 days of sessions.
claims.quote: The sessions list shows sessions from the past 28 days only.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics and a revised rollout schedule for this roadmap item are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Monitor cost visibility lifecycle 571196 default rollout license price authoring; opened the roadmap record, agents-experience/analytics-overview and authoring-review-activity. No item-specific rollout mechanics or replacement schedule were found.

claims.claim: Learn's governance article recommends classifying environments as exploration, test or production.
claims.quote: Classify environments as exploration, test and validation, or funded production.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness usage is not included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: This usage isn't included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
